purpose: Paired dropout-only training-fit diagnostic, not validation model selection
selection_rule: Compare final epoch 100 for all paired seeds; retain predeclared learning curves, no best-epoch selection
limits: No changes to widths, normalization, Adam, batch size, epochs, scaler, panel, class weights or shuffle policy
Only dropout changes; its removal intentionally changes stochastic masking during training
Training-only fits cannot establish generalization or justify removing production dropout
Do not rerun or tune the tree baseline; no cloud training or model promotion
